name: Mia Boonen
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 1)
description: With over 5 years of experience working in mental health across community services, acute settings, policy reform, and creative arts programs, I offer a grounded and welcoming space for young people (aged 5-25) to explore their mental health, seek support, and work toward meaningful change. My approach is collaborative, trauma-informed and values-led, constructing safe spaces for children and young people to share honestly, be seen, and navigate challenges. I specialise in work with young people facing school refusal, neurodivergent folks, and LGBTQIA+ clients, with over five years of professional experience (as well as my own lived experience of queerness, disability and autism) to support the work.

name: Michael Saxon
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
description: Thumos is a counselling and mental health service based in Melbourne, Australia. We support children, young people and their families to navigate challenges and life transitions through the key pillars of Understanding, Change and Connection. We also provide specialised support to young people in care, who have had contact with the youth justice system or those who have experienced trauma and attachment disruption.
